name: flipped_draft_drops
why: The same draft, same angle, same faces, with «flip». The part must SHRINK instead of growing. It is the half that makes `part_grew` a measurement and not a constant: a field that always answers «true» tells nothing apart, and the direction of a wrong draft gives no error -- you see it only by looking at the part from the side.
_why_the_two_numbers_are_not_equal: Growing adds 7080.74 mm3, shrinking removes 6917.45. It is not a suspicious asymmetry: it is geometry. Widening towards the bottom adds a frustum of a pyramid bigger than the prism; narrowing removes a smaller one, because the section decreases downwards instead of increasing. If the two numbers were equal, it would mean someone is approximating.

expect.why: flipped or not, the walls are at 5 degrees: it is the DIRECTION that changes, not the angle

expect._why_false: THE LINE THIS CASE EXISTS FOR. In the straight case the same field answers true.

expect.tolerance_why: frustum of a pyramid, the calculation has a tangent inside
the same number read from the state
